contract.name: code-review-depth

descriptions.skip: No review needed: cannot change shipped behaviour. Docs, comments, formatting, generated code from an unchanged spec, mechanical renames or moves with identical values, dev-only tooling.
descriptions.shallow: A quick look is enough: touches shipped code or config but not production behaviour that matters. Tests, log or message text, metrics, type hints, patch bumps of shipped dependencies, staging or CI config, code behind a flag that is off.
descriptions.deep: Needs a careful technical review: changes production logic. Control flow, defaults, queries, caching, concurrency, retries, error handling, API behaviour.
descriptions.human: Needs a responsible human to sign off: money, auth or permissions, sessions, personal data, irreversible migrations, secrets, production infrastructure or security rules.

contract.instructions: How much review does this pull request need before merging? Judge by what the change does, not by its title or size.
